units.source_text: 叶子自然没留意别人这样观察她。

en.t: Yoko, naturally, did not notice that someone was watching her like that.

units.source_text: 她的心全用在病人身上，就是把脸转向岛村那边，她也不会看见自己映在窗玻璃上的身影，更不会去注意那个眺望着窗外的男人。

en.t: Her whole heart was fixed on the sick man; even if she turned her face toward Shimamura, she would not see her own reflection in the window glass, much less notice the man gazing outside.
